svg.title: Surf-Storage Mandichosee traced from rendered reference
svg.desc: This SVG is traced directly from the rendered reference image so the lettering style matches the preview much more closely than the previous font-based approximation. Paths are grouped by connected black shape clusters.
svg.metadata: Source image: rendered Surf-Storage Mandichosee logo. Note: because many letters connect in script form, this trace is grouped by connected shape clusters rather than perfectly isolated letters.
